own_solution.law: Conical pendulum period 2 pi sqrt(L cos(theta)/g)
assumptions: steady horizontal circle at stated angle

defect_reasons.other: In T5418/T0789 'before the bob is set moving' is slightly ambiguous about which bob, since the second bob hangs at rest; the answer is unaffected.

notes: Verified certified answers: L = 1.6 m -> 2.3626 s, 1.9 m -> 2.5746 s, 2.3 m -> 2.8327 s; base 2.04608 s. Mass cancellation expression reduces to 2 pi sqrt(L cos(theta)/g). Minimal pairs T5418/T41B5 and T422F/TC5DB share 0.7 m and differ in attachment/time only; numeral-free twins match their numbered D twins. Agrees with pass 1.
